visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a street view near Yakuin Station in Fukuoka, Japan. Several pedestrians walk along the sidewalk while a cyclist travels on the road next to yellow tactile paving. Large, bold pink and white text overlays occupy the center of the frame against a clear sky background. (2) Inside B.B.B POTTERS, the camera focuses on a dense collection of woven baskets of various sizes and shapes stacked on the floor. The background shows wooden shelves filled with kitchenware, ceramics, and miscellaneous lifestyle goods under bright indoor lighting. A hand picks up a blue plaid ceramic mug to show its detail. (3) The scene transitions to the HIGHTIDE STORE, starting with a shot of its modern wooden and glass exterior with a small bench outside. Inside, the camera pans across organized wooden shelves stocked with colorful stationery, storage boxes, and pens. Close-ups feature rows of stickers and local-themed keychains held in hands. (4) At tenir, the interior showcases a vintage aesthetic with rustic wooden furniture and white-framed windows. The shop features an integrated flower display with various plants and dried blooms. Elegantly arranged ceramic plates, glasses, and decorative items are presented on shelves and a central dining table. (5) The camera captures the large glass storefront of ALSO MOONSTAR, showing a clean, modern interior with rows of shoes on display. The exterior is a grey textured wall with a small sign. Finally, a shot of NONE TOO SOON displays its minimalist white entryway and clear signage.
